cards.headline: Voters turned away AI's data centres. Where does AI live now?
cards.line: A data centre is the giant warehouse of computers that runs AI.

cards.headline: Voters backed limits on new data centres in 40 out of 41 local votes, after rows over power bills.
Voters fear a giant data centre will push up their own power bill.
cards.line: Of Americans whose bills rose, 43% call data centres a major reason.

cards.headline: To dodge the fights, builders now bring their own power plants, and some AI runs on phones instead.
cards.line: One tracker counts 59 planned US data centres with their own power plants; others spread out into small sites.

cards.headline: Ask the company selling you AI where its new computing gets built, and who pays for power.
cards.line: Where it is built decides its cost, its delays and its promises.
cards.board: WHERE IS IT BUILT? | WHO PAYS FOR POWER?

cards.headline: Where AI gets built now decides what AI costs you and where it runs.
cards.board: WHERE IT'S BUILT = WHAT IT COSTS
